description: This file contains functions and preferences for configuring Firefox profiles, including default preferences and writing preferences to profile directories, used in testing or automation contexts.

methods.name: createProfile
methods.description: Creates a Firefox profile directory if it doesn't exist and writes default preferences into it.

methods.name: defaultProfilePreferences
methods.description: Generates a set of default Firefox profile preferences, optionally extended with extra preferences.

methods.name: writePreferences
methods.description: Writes preferences to the profile's prefs.js and creates backups if necessary.
